correctness.rationale: For fixed minimum width w>0 and radius R>=w, v=(sqrt((4R²-(R-w)²)/3)-(R-w))/2, rho=w-v,c=R-rho solve R²=c²+cv+v². Erosion by s in [0,rho] commutes with intersection of three radius-R disks, yielding three radius-(R-s) disks centered at cu_j and eroded vertices at v_s=(sqrt(4(R-s)²-3c²)-c)/2. Their core plus three circular segments has exact area G(s)=3sqrt3 v_s²/4+(3/2)(R-s)²(alpha_s-sin alpha_s), alpha_s=2asin(sqrt3 v_s/[2(R-s)]). G strictly decreases G(0)>0 to G(rho)=0 while pi s² increases; unique s* solves G(s*)=pi s*². The standard planar convex Cheeger theorem gives set erosion+s*B and six alternating arcs with turning angles alpha_s* and 2pi/3-alpha_s*. As R→infinity, direct uniform expansion near s0=w/(3+sqrt(pi sqrt3)) and nonzero root derivative give s*=w/H+[w²(H²+6H-9)/(6H³)]/R+O(w³/R²), h=H/w-[(H²+6H-9)/(6H)]/R+O(w/R²). Independently recomputed roots, area formula and leading correction at R=1,2,10,100,1000; universal result derives from exact geometry plus implicit-function theorem.
